document.abstract: A new light source developed by OSRAM GmbH, originally for remote television lighting, is now also being applied to film applications. The lamps high efficacy, daylight quality, full spectrum, compact size, ease of ballasting and rugged construction make them ideal for this service. They are available in 575-, 1200-, 2500-, and 4000-W sizes to meet the needs of various television and film lighting requirements. This new lamp family is an answer to the industry's search for advancements in lighting systems, especially heightened by the energy crisis.
